Questions, answered

Start with confidence.

Can I try NutriMate without an account?+

Yes. Guests can upload a photo as a visual reference and manually add foods for an instant estimate.

Why do I review the AI result?+

Meal photos can hide ingredients and make portion sizes difficult to judge. Review keeps you in control of the final record.

Does NutriMate give medical advice?+

No. Nutrition values are practical estimates and should not replace advice from a qualified health professional.
